run_policy: Run when SoftwareSet/reconciler changes; PackSet-only releases do not require the infrastructure chaos suite. Never run while a promotion is in progress.

experiments.steady_state: API and worker healthy before injection; staging connection strings point to proxy listener
experiments.hypothesis: database failure does not corrupt writes or trigger unbounded retries
success: toxic is applied end-to-end through Toxiproxy
service recovers safely after toxic removal

experiments.hypothesis: a worker crash produces bounded recovery without duplicate side effects
success: idempotency prevents duplicate external side effects

experiments.hypothesis: an interrupted pack fetch never activates a partial candidate
success: digest verification is required before activation

experiments.hypothesis: a revoked digest cannot be activated, restored by rollback, or re-applied by reconciliation
success: running revoked content quarantined even during freeze or desired-state signature failure
reconciler refuses signed desired state that still names revoked digest

experiments.hypothesis: loss of authority transport is fail-static and never causes an unverified fallback
success: no cached unverified desired state is applied
no lower sequence or tag fallback occurs

experiments.inject: fallocate filler file to safe threshold on staging filesystem
experiments.steady_state: staging Docker/PostgreSQL data is isolated from control-plane filesystem and sufficient headroom exists
experiments.hypothesis: staging disk exhaustion fails safely without taking down control-plane state
success: promotion service, Governor and review ledger remain healthy
no destructive cleanup or volume prune runs automatically
recovery after filler removal is clean

experiments.inject: reboot after pull and before activation
experiments.steady_state: candidate images pulled but current release active; no promotion in progress
experiments.hypothesis: host loss mid-deploy cannot leave a half-activated release or lose control-plane state
success: boot resumes last healthy release or safely completes verified activation
promotion service returns healthy with no key/state loss
review ledger returns healthy with no state loss

experiments.inject: several-hours slow and several-hours fast clock skew plus NTP-unsynchronized state
experiments.steady_state: NTP synchronized and signed desired state valid
experiments.hypothesis: time failure cannot silently bypass expiry/freshness controls
success: future-issued desired state beyond tolerance fails static
expired state is never accepted as valid
valid state is not silently rejected without alert

moved_to_integration_tests.reason: Governor retry/spend/permission limits are control-plane integration properties, not infrastructure chaos.
